name: real_scan_bf
sql: select ten287_bot.load_ticks('Betfair Exchange', '2026-09-12T00:00:00Z', '2026-09-29T06:02:00Z') loaded, ten287_bot.scan('Betfair Exchange', '2026-09-26T00:00:00Z', '2026-09-29T06:02:00Z', 5, 'backtest', 'ten348-bf') fired

name: real_alerts
sql: select run_id, event_id, side, tier, eval_at, ref_price, ref_at, cur_price, cur_at, pct_10m from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id in ('ten348-sb','ten348-bf') order by run_id, eval_at

name: cleanup
sql: delete from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id in ('ten348-sb','ten348-bf') returning id

name: tick_counts
sql: select t.book, e.tier, (t.seen_at at time zone 'utc')::date as d, t.src, count(*) n, count(distinct t.event_id) ev from ten287_rec.ticks t left join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1,2,3,4
